running.meaning: The engine has started this run and is actively working through tasks; the initial status written when state is first created.

passed.meaning: A single task's implement->test loop finished clean; a per-task status, not the top-level run status.

failed.meaning: A single task's implement->test loop did not finish clean after its retry budget; a per-task status, not the top-level run status.

blocked.meaning: The run bailed before reaching a terminal outcome (a task failed and triage judged it stuck, or another stop condition fired) -- the top-level run status when a bail occurred.

done.meaning: The run completed cleanly: every task passed, and (sdlc-task only) the terminal reconcile and acceptance-criteria verdict did not refuse the close.

criteria_refused.meaning: sdlc-task only: every task passed and reconcile succeeded, but the acceptance-criteria verdict stage refused a clean close -- replaces a would-be 'done' status; the block is not closed.

reconcile_failed.meaning: sdlc-task only: every task passed its own fast per-task tripwire, but the terminal authoritative reconcile (D56) -- re-running checks the fast path had substituted or skipped -- failed; the block is not closed.

review.meaning: sdlc-flow only: the run has finished the task loop and is in the end-of-flow review stage over the integrated tree.

docs.meaning: sdlc-flow only: review passed and the run is now in the documentation-patch stage.

wrapup.meaning: sdlc-flow only: docs are patched and the run is in its final wrap-up/PR stage.
